answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in inlet, checked in thread, and cedar shows each void. A farm of 3377 identities would post 4115 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
